C0138.title: Tampering with Game Data for Illegal Profit: Shanghai Songjiang Police Dismantle a Game Recharge Fraud Ring
C0138.summary: In June 2024, during the 'Lijian 2024' special operation, Shanghai Songjiang police dismantled a criminal gang engaged in game recharge fraud by compromising computer information systems. The gang illegally obtained virtual assets such as in-game currency by tampering with game data, then sold recharge services at low prices for profit.

references.title: Tampering with Game Data for Illegal Profits! Songjiang Police Bust a Game Black Market Top-Up Criminal Gang_Shanghai Observer News
